'''Javaal''' was the seventh and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Brenta]] in the [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal system]],<ref name="CW" /><ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Javaal was a ball of [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] [[Water/Legends|ice]] and rock<ref name="CE" /> without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="CW" /><ref name="EA" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the space above Javaal was the theater of a [[Battle of Javaal|battle]] concluded with a Republic victory.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=space|Javaal Fleet Action}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal system]], except [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], were introduced in the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''.<ref name="CW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Brentaal star system in grid square L-9.<ref name="EA" />

The Space Mission "Javaal Fleet Action" in the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Javaal.<ref name="TOR" />
